review.scope_description: Only taxonomy[0] GTDB block/status, actual application and appended history, and eight scoped native checks. limitations: Partial technical diagnostic with scientific_review:false. Native gates do not establish full scientific review, measured snippet validation, current products, corpus QC or campaign completion.

Coverage is the complete canonical record and retained main-text strain construction, inoculation, cultivation and carbon-interpretation passages. No new supplemental TableS1/S2, original figure pixels, plasmid sequence, engineered-genome assembly or isotope-flux audit was performed.

The exact NCBI1148 population supplies total_genomes22 and majority_fraction1.0 without an explicit support_genomes numerator. It is not22 experimental constructs, a cell count, viable count, a5:1 cell ratio, or a sequence-confirmed engineered stock. The shared generic population does not make this stock interchangeable with PPHET PPT1.

Preserve WT_PKPa_RBS_BsPta_Δacs and its source-described engineering. The GTDB placeholder does not rename the strain or verify its introduced sequences. BL21(DE3) Pem7_ButOH and its existing Escherichia coli block remain unchanged; that old generic166397-genome population and historical release wording are not newly certified or assigned to the experimental BL21 stock.

Pseudomonas taiwanensis is a separate experimental consortium, E.coli T7 is a subcloning host, and the Pthl construct is a distinct tested version. None becomes an additional member of this two-member canonical pair.

The OPEN carbon-specificity discussion, two interaction nodes and one HYPOTHESIZED/PARTIAL arrow remain unchanged. Lower extracellular acetate and CFU recovery support uptake but do not quantify isotope-resolved acetate-to-butanol flux or exclude secreted carbohydrates and extracellular polysaccharides. ATP/NAD(P)H limitation is a proposed explanation; evaporation and product reuptake remain alternatives.

Preserve inoculation OD at different wavelengths versus cell ratios,30C culture versus37C colony recovery, adaptation assays versus42-day coculture, two independent pairings versus a three-member culture, and bicarbonate/pH refreshes versus steady-state concentrations. Mapping adds no product-carbon provenance or quantitative causal claim.

Actual staging, application and all eight commands ran at frozen M5 bfef6b2a7684bfc4bb4a22fb1b1234faf797536b with Python3.13.2. Independent candidate and gate-configuration reviews preceded execution. All eight free plans preceded serial actual checks; mirroring preserves execution metadata.
Crosswalk761 identifies exact bytes, with release unestablished. The NCBI authority observation is file identity/stat rather than a full database digest or a certified ontology release.

The complete four-record route remains private and includes unselected populations. Preserve batch137's immutable ledger, original497 predecessor, all current biological/cache predicates and existing498/499/500 admissions. Full input checkpoints precede caller changes. Final integration and aggregate checks are separate.
